snippet.title: Jackson Family Tours Indiana Home: Prince Praises Uncles and Family Legacy

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Memorial at His Childhood Home | 2300 Jackson Street, Gary Indiana #michaeljackson
snippet.description:
This short video shows the memorial plaque dedicated to the King of Pop, Michael Jackson, at his childhood home in Gary, Indiana.

The house at **2300 Jackson Street** is a modest 672-square-foot, two-bedroom bungalow built in 1949. Joe and Katherine Jackson bought it in 1950 and raised their nine children here, including Michael, Janet, and the Jackson 5. The family lived in this small home until 1969, when they moved to California after signing with Motown.

In front of the house stands this beautiful black granite memorial featuring Michael’s silhouette performing the moonwalk, his birth date (August 29, 1958), and passing date (June 25, 2009). It reads “Home Town of Michael Jackson – Gary, IN” and includes the touching line: “Never can say goodbye”.

Fans from around the world leave locks and messages on the fence as a tribute.

A powerful symbol of humble beginnings and legendary talent. ❤️

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Remembered In Hometown
snippet.description: Weeks after his death, a steady stream of fans continues to visit Gary, Indiana where pop star Michael Jackson was born. Even though Jackson visited only once after becoming a star, people in Gary, an economically depressed city, feel a strong bond with the star and his family. On Friday, more than six thousand fans gathered in Gary for a memorial service to the King of Pop. And as VOA's Kane Farabaugh reports, plans are underway to build a museum and memorial to the late singer.

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Childhood Home in Gary, Indiana
snippet.description:
The Childhood Home of Michael Jackson in Gary, Indiana from our visit in June of 2022.  This is the birthplace home and the home Michael Jackson grew up in with his parents Joe and Katherine Jackson along with his siblings.  This is the home where Michael practiced music 5 hours a day for 3 years until making his debut as part of the Jackson 5 in Gary, Indiana.  They played numerous shows around town until being discovered at a local talent show by Diana Ross and signed to Motown Records before moving to Los Angeles.  Michael Jackson ended up becoming not only the King of Pop but one of the best selling artists of all time despite having a troubled adulthood full of controversy.  I hope you enjoy this short look at the Michael Jackson boyhood home.

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Grew Up in This Tiny House (Gary, Indiana)… Then He Changed the World 😳🏠
snippet.description:
This is the childhood home where Michael Jackson and the entire Jackson family grew up in Gary, Indiana… and it’s hard to believe what came from here 😳🏠

Over 9 children lived inside this small two-bedroom house on Jackson Street, where the Jackson 5 practiced for hours every day before becoming global superstars. The Jackson 5 would go on to change music forever—but it all started right here.

snippet.title: Michael Jackson Returned to the Tiny Home Where It All Began
snippet.description:
Newly circulated footage shows Michael Jackson returning to 2300 Jackson Street—the modest Gary, Indiana home where his extraordinary journey began.

Inside the house, Michael remembers where his family slept and brings his familiar sense of humor back into the rooms that helped shape the Jackson 5. WWETV Studios pairs the newly promoted scenes with complementary archival footage of Michael’s emotional homecoming, revealing a broader picture of his return.

Before the world called him the King of Pop, this house simply called him Michael.

The newly circulated material was filmed by producer Marc Schaffel between 2000 and 2003 for an unreleased Michael Jackson reality project. Schaffel is reportedly developing the archive as a potential three-part documentary series.

This is BLACK TO THE FUTURE—where the archive explains the future of the culture.

What do you think Michael felt walking through his childhood home again?

Footage sources: F. Marc Schaffel Productions/The Sun and archival news footage.

snippet.title: On This Day in MJ HIStory: Michael Jackson Returns to Gary, Indiana (June 11, 2003) #musichistory
snippet.description:
On this day in MJ HIStory, June 11, 2003, Michael Jackson returned to his childhood home in Gary, Indiana, for the first time in nearly 20 years.

The King of Pop visited the modest house where he and his brothers began their remarkable journey to global superstardom. Following the visit, then-Mayor Scott L. King presented Michael Jackson with the Key to the City, recognizing his extraordinary contributions to music, entertainment, and the city’s legacy.

Thousands of fans gathered around City Hall and along the streets of Gary to catch a glimpse of Michael. Before leaving, he greeted supporters, signed autographs, and thanked the community that helped shape his early years.

The visit was a powerful homecoming and a reminder of Michael’s deep connection to Gary, Indiana. At the time, local school district officials were also discussing plans to honor him by naming a school in recognition of his achievements and influence.

More than two decades later, this memorable day remains a cherished moment in Michael Jackson history.
